# Pixel Task List

A fully offline, single-page task list with pixel-art styling. Built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript — no frameworks, no network requests, no storage.

## Features

- Add tasks via the **Add** button or the **Enter** key.
- Input is trimmed; blank or whitespace-only input is ignored.
- Total task count (`#todo-total`) and incomplete count (`#remaining`) update live.
- Each task gets a checkbox (`#todo-check-N`), text span (`#todo-text-N`), and delete button (`#todo-delete-N`), where `N` is an increasing numeric ID starting at 1.
- Toggling a checkbox updates the incomplete count.
- Deleting a task removes it and updates both counts.
- All state is kept in memory; nothing is persisted.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or internet connection required.

## Accessibility

- All controls are keyboard accessible and labeled (visible `<label>`, `aria-label`, and focus outlines).
- Layout works from 360px wide.

## Constraints

- Only `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`, and this README.
- No imports, packages, external assets, iframes, or server code.
- Total source lines under 240.
